summary: A member says a no vote on a tax rise is not a vote against the pay raises in the same budget.
realLife: In a mid-size city's budget vote, the mayor and one member opposed the property tax increase. The mayor said her no was not aimed at city employees. The other member said the raises were good but the tax would fall on residents, renters included. A third member who disliked the tax voted yes anyway, citing police resignations and pay below nearby departments.
sources: WFDD (Greensboro, North Carolina), 'Greensboro City Council passes $751M budget with property tax increase', June 21, 2023: https://wfdd.org/story/greensboro-city-council-passes-751m-budget-property-tax-increase-0
